'''Bosph StarCrystals''' were gems from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]]. The [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bora Boru]] had a Bosph StarCrystal attached to the tip of a staff he carried.
